name: strawberry-snake
description: Open this folder in VS Code. Run `python -m http.server 8080` (or `python3 -m http.server 8080`) in its terminal, then open http://localhost:8080 in Chrome or Edge. Internet is needed for MediaPipe CDN and model downloads. Click Play with camera and allow access, or Play with pointer. Camera frames are processed locally. The game uses screen-space AR overlays, not room-scale depth tracking. The 60-second timer begins after the camera tracker is ready; losing tracking does not stop the timer. Exit game releases the camera. No npm installation is needed.
